en: Look, your name's in the ledger already.
I have no need to stay the night.
What the hell? All you ever do is come in and gawk,
and you've got no call to talk to me like that.
The highway is dangerous, with bandits around.
At night you'd best stay at an inn, it's risky.
There's no other village around here,
so any traveler who comes by stays the night.
And yet lately the customers have dried up completely.
Maybe something happened...
With no customers, my prized cooking skills
go to waste.
I turn cheap ingredients into pricey dishes.
Say, why don't you try my cooking?
If it's when I'm not running the inn,
I'll serve it to you cheap.
Hardly any customers come,
and there's no other place to stay around here.
On top of that, they get a top-notch meal,
so if I charge a bit extra for the room,
that's only natural, isn't it?
Greedy one, your cunning is
note: Cut at the matching point with #1382

en: well suited to the role of a servant, don't you think?
Little by little, my thirst is being quenched...
The countless desires that swirl through the human world
moisten my throat...
No,
I'm staying at a villa to the east.
I've no use for folks who don't stay.
Yes, I'd love some.
I've never even tried a stew.
No kidding...
I've no use for folks who aren't staying.
You want to stay here, do you?
Look, your name's in the ledger already.
You can't just say that...
Oh, the spelling is wrong.
That isn't me, I'm afraid.
Pah, what's this? A gawker, and
acting all high and mighty...
There isn't another village around here,
I wonder if something happened...
Please let me be of use to you.
Cows... Cows sure are nice...
Good morning...
I'm just heading to the cowshed.
I'm off to work now.
Hey, good morning,
Good afternoon...
Good day...
I'm just heading home now.
This is my place. I'm Ios.
I live here with my wife, Wendy.
Oh, did you want something?
What is it?
Let me relax at home, will you?
Well? Do you have some kind of grudge against me?
Ah, welcome.
Feel free to stay as long as you like.
I'm taking it easy myself.
Make yourself at home.
I don't mind, and Wendy isn't much of
a woman for standing on ceremony.
Because she's like that,
we manage to get along as a married couple.
I'm Ios, I take care of the cows here.
Ah, the outsider everyone talks about,
that would be you, then.
Hm, I hadn't heard I was called that,
but I suppose it is true.
But I don't mind things like that.
That doesn't mean we'll be friends right away,
that's not how it works, mind you.
I'm Ios, I look after the cows here, you know.
Do you like cows?
<I like them>
